title: Linus Tech Tips Built the “Best PC” of 2026. The Specs Are Completely Absurd. | VoltTech
description: Linus Tech Tips built its fastest off-the-shelf PC of 2026 around AMD's Ryzen 9 9950X3D2 and MSI's RTX 5090 Lightning Z. STATIC breaks down the hardware, the excess and what the build actually tells us about flagship PCs.
